name: French Polynesia
prevalence_note: The High Commission in French Polynesia publishes an FAQ on scam attempts and identity fraud by internet or SMS.
cross_border_note: French Polynesia (+689) has eight-digit numbers; messages using mainland French formats or foreign prefixes are a signal worth checking.

scams.name: Usurpation de l'administration par SMS ou internet
scams.name_en: Message posing as the administration asking for card, login or fee in French Polynesia
scams.signals_en: An SMS or email posing as a public office asks for card details, login credentials or a fee to settle a file.
scams.legit_en: The High Commission's FAQ on internet and SMS fraud attempts advises caution and checking with the real office directly.
bait_tactics: Demander quel service administratif de Papeete suit le dossier
Dire que les papiers seront déposés au guichet en personne
